tagline: Log records and count their days
summary: A single list of records, each with a start and an end date, a status, and the number of days it spans; flag the ones starting soon and total the days.

constants.name: SOON_WINDOW_DAYS
constants.comment: 'soon' is read as the next 7 days

filters.label: Starting soon
filters.rule: days until Start is at most SOON_WINDOW_DAYS

badges.rule: days until Start is at most SOON_WINDOW_DAYS

journeys.title: adds a record and shows its span
journeys.steps: Add a record with Name, Start today and End three days from today; save
journeys.expect: The record is listed and shows its Span

journeys.title: rejects an empty required field
journeys.steps: Add a record with Name blank; save
journeys.expect: The form shows 'Name is required.' and nothing is added

journeys.title: edits a record and recomputes its span
journeys.steps: Edit the record and move End one day later; save
journeys.expect: The record's Span is one day larger

journeys.title: deletes a record
journeys.expect: The record is no longer listed

journeys.title: filters to the records starting soon
journeys.expect: Only records whose Start is inside the window are listed

journeys.title: flags a record starting soon
journeys.steps: Add a record whose Start is inside the window
journeys.expect: The record shows the 'Starting soon' badge

journeys.title: totals the days across every record
journeys.expect: The stat shows the sum of every record's Span

journeys.title: preserves records across a browser refresh
journeys.steps: Add a record; refresh the browser
journeys.expect: The record is still listed with the same values

omitted_patterns.reason: The idea describes one person on one computer

assumptions: SOON_WINDOW_DAYS is 7, reading 'soon' as the coming week
Span is the whole number of days from Start to End
